sentences.text: The internet is single-player.
We share a link, everyone reads it alone, and the conversation happens somewhere else.
LinkRoom puts the people back on the page.
Every link and every PDF becomes a live room.
Your dashboard shows which rooms are running, who is reading right now, your study groups, and a shared calendar, all in one place.
Add as many sources as you need.
Drop in PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Markdown files, paste a web link, or pull straight from Google Drive.
Every source sits side by side, and you choose which ones the AI should use.
Got a lecture on YouTube?
Paste the link, and LinkRoom reads the captions, turning the video into a timestamped document your group can highlight and question, just like text.
Reading together means marking things up.
Highlight, underline, draw, or drop a text box anywhere on the page.
Every mark shows up in your own colour, live, for everyone in the room.
You can always see where everyone is.
Live cursors show each reader's position, the activity feed tracks every highlight and question, and follow mode lets you ride along with a friend's scroll.
Need everyone on the same line?
Laser Focus pulls the whole room to your paragraph in one click.
Everyone, look here.
When typing is too slow, start a huddle.
Talk it through by voice with live captions, and when you hang up, the AI writes the notes: questions, action items and key points, anchored to the passages you were reading.
AI Lens lets you drag over any part of a page, a diagram, a table, a scanned equation, and ask about exactly that.
AI chat answers across all of your sources, with citations that jump straight to the passage.
And Studio turns your sources into study material in one click.
A summary.
A quiz to check what stuck.
Flashcards to remember key terms.
A mind map of how ideas connect.
And a one-page infographic.
Rooms are dynamic.
Organise them into groups, decide who can view or edit, chat in the discussion tab, keep a shared notebook, and catch up instantly with While you were away.
Reading was never meant to be a solitary act.
LinkRoom.
Make your next read multiplayer.
